description: Get full detail for a single Manifold market by its URL slug or id. Provide exactly one of slug/id. For multiple-choice markets, returns each answer with its probability (top 12). Includes plain-text description, creator, volume, liquidity, and resolution. Keyless.

slug.description: Market URL slug — the part after manifold.markets/{user}/, e.g. "who-will-win-the-2026-california-gu".

name: manifold_get_market
title: Manifold Get Market
